leap.status.description: how the chrony is handling leap seconds

ntp.frequency.offset.description: The frequency is the rate by which the system s clock would be wrong if chronyd was not correcting it.
ntp.frequency.offset.extended_documentation: It is expressed in ppm (parts per million). For example, a value of 1 ppm would mean that when the system’s clock thinks it has advanced 1 second, it has actually advanced by 1.000001 seconds relative to true time.

ntp.skew.description: This is the estimated error bound on the frequency.

ntp.stratum.description: The number of hops away from the reference system keeping the reference time

ntp.time.correction.description: The number of seconds difference between the system's clock and the reference clock

ntp.time.last_offset.description: The estimated local offset on the last clock update

ntp.time.rms_offset.description: the long term average of the offset value

ntp.time.root_delay.description: This is the total of the network path delays to the stratum-1 system from which the system is ultimately synchronised.
